Substitution, RB Leipzig. Castello Lukeba replaces Nicolas Seiwald.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Johan Bakayoko replaces Antonio Nusa.

Second Half ends, RB Leipzig 2, VfL Wolfsburg 2.
